title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for Accelerating the Establishment of a Unified National Market
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for Accelerating the Establishment of a Unified National Market

Fa Fa [2022] No. 22

In order to thoroughly implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the plenary sessions of its 19th Central Committee, earnestly implement the "Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on Accelerating the Establishment of a Unified National Market," give full play to the functional role of the People's Courts, and provide high-quality judicial services and safeguards for accelerating the establishment of a unified national market, these Opinions are formulated based on the actual work of the People's Courts.

I. General Requirements

1. Effectively enhance the sense of responsibility and mission in providing judicial services and safeguards for accelerating the establishment of a unified national market. Accelerating the establishment of an efficient, standardized, fair, competitive, and fully open unified national market is a major strategic deployment made by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core from an overall and strategic perspective, and is the basic support and inherent requirement for building a new development pattern. People's Courts at all levels must earnestly unify their thoughts and actions with the major strategic deployment of the Central Committee, deeply grasp the decisive significance of the "Two Establishments," enhance "Four Consciousnesses," strengthen "Four Confidences," and achieve "Two Upholds," continuously improve political judgment, political understanding, and political execution, adhere to serving the overall situation, administering justice for the people, and exercising impartial justice, faithfully fulfill the duties conferred by the Constitution and laws, give full play to the role of the rule of law in regulation, guidance, and guarantee, and provide high-quality judicial services and safeguards for accelerating the establishment of a unified national market.

2. Accurately grasp the entry points and focal points for providing judicial services and safeguards for accelerating the establishment of a unified national market. People's Courts at all levels must closely focus on the major decisions and deployments of the Central Committee, adhere to the "Two Unswerving," uphold a problem-oriented approach, fully, accurately, and comprehensively implement the new development philosophy, strengthen systematic thinking, focus on coordination and cooperation, actively take on responsibilities, coordinate precise efforts in all areas and links of legislation, adjudication, and enforcement, coordinate the unified protection of market entities, factors, rules, and order, benchmark against and continuously promote the efficient and smooth operation and scale expansion of the domestic market, accelerate the creation of a stable, fair, transparent, and predictable business environment, further reduce market transaction costs, promote technological innovation and industrial upgrading, and cultivate new advantages for participating in international competition and cooperation. Targeted improvement of judicial policies, innovation of work mechanisms, enhancement of judicial quality and efficiency, continuous improvement of the effectiveness of judicial services and safeguards, better play the decisive role of the market in resource allocation, and provide strong judicial support for building a high-standard market system and a high-level socialist market economy system.

II. Strengthening Unified Equal Protection of Market Entities

3. Assist in implementing unified market access. Lawfully hear disputes over construction projects, real estate, mineral resources, and contracts for the allocation of factors and market access such as water, electricity, gas, and heat, accurately grasp the impact of the relaxation of market access in natural monopoly industries and service industries on contract validity, and strictly implement the "non-prohibited equals permitted" policy. Lawfully hear administrative cases involving market access, support the promotion of administrative examination and approval system reform by classification and grading, and curb improper interference in economic activities, especially the abuse of administrative power to exclude or restrict competition. Strengthen the incidental review of administrative normative documents such as the negative list for market access and the directory list of preferential policies for enterprises, promote administrative organs to promptly clean up and abolish normative documents containing local protection, market segmentation, designated transactions, and other obstacles to a unified market and fair competition, and eliminate local protection and regional barriers.

4. Strengthen equal protection of property rights. Adhere to the equal litigation status, equal application of law, and equal legal liability of all market entities, and lawfully and equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of all types of market entities. Strictly distinguish between economic disputes, administrative violations, and criminal offenses, resolutely prevent the treatment of economic disputes as criminal offenses, and resolutely prevent the conversion of civil liability into criminal liability. Lawfully punish crimes and illegal acts that infringe upon property rights, improve the mechanism for the recovery and disposal of involved property, and maximize the recovery of stolen goods and compensation. Fully implement the concept of good faith and civilized enforcement, further regulate coercive measures involving property rights, strictly prohibit exceeding the subject matter or illegally sealing property, flexibly adopt sealing and realization measures, and effectively release the use value and financing function of sealed property. Improve the appeal and retrial mechanisms for property rights cases involving enterprises, and improve the effective prevention and correction mechanism for wrongful property rights cases. Support and standardize coercive measures involving property rights in the field of administrative law enforcement, and lawfully safeguard the autonomy of market entities in business operations.

5. Lawfully and equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties. Study and formulate judicial interpretations on the ascertainment of foreign laws and the application of international treaties and international practices, and accurately apply extraterritorial laws, international treaties, and international practices. Optimize the litigation jurisdiction mechanism for foreign-related civil and commercial disputes, and study and formulate judicial interpretations on the jurisdiction of first-instance foreign-related civil and commercial cases. Strengthen judicial cooperation, improve the mechanism for foreign-related service of process, and promote the establishment of a unified platform for extraterritorial service. Promote the substantive operation of the International Commercial Court, improve the working mechanism of the International Commercial Expert Committee, improve the one-stop information platform for international commercial dispute resolution, achieve organic integration of mediation, arbitration, and litigation, and strive to create a new high ground for international commercial dispute resolution. Accurately apply foreign investment laws and regulations, fully implement the pre-establishment national treatment plus negative list system for foreign investment, lawfully maintain the validity of foreign investment contracts, and promote fair competition between domestic and foreign-funded enterprises. Promote the construction of the legal system for the extraterritorial application of Chinese law, and lawfully protect the legitimate rights and interests of "going global" enterprises and citizens.

6. Improve the market entity rescue and exit mechanism. Adhere to the market-oriented, rule-of-law, professional, and information-oriented direction of bankruptcy adjudication, lawfully and steadily hear bankruptcy cases, and promote the survival of the fittest among enterprises. Adhere to precise identification and classified measures, and for enterprises that are in financial distress but still have development prospects and rescue value, actively apply bankruptcy reorganization and bankruptcy conciliation procedures, promote the optimization of production factor combinations and enterprise transformation and upgrading, revitalize enterprises, and make market resource allocation more efficient. Actively promote the improvement of the bankruptcy legal system and supporting mechanisms, improve the mechanism for the orderly connection between enforcement and bankruptcy work, promote the amendment of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law and individual bankruptcy legislation, promote the establishment of bankruptcy administrator associations and the establishment of special funds for bankruptcy expenses, and promote the establishment of a normalized "government-court coordination" mechanism.

7. Lawfully and promptly realize the victorious rights and interests of market entities.

Further improve and perfect the comprehensive governance framework for the difficulty in enforcement, strengthen the comprehensive governance and source management assessment of the difficulty in enforcement, promote the integration of enforcement work into grassroots grid management, improve the coordination and cooperation mechanism of legislation, adjudication, and enforcement, and ensure the timely realization of the goal of "effectively solving the difficulty in enforcement." Further strengthen the informatization construction of enforcement, expand and upgrade system functions, strengthen enforcement node management, and improve the automation and intelligence level of enforcement process supervision. Explore the establishment of systems such as lawyer investigation of the property of the person subject to enforcement, promote the implementation of systems such as entrusted audit investigation, notarized evidence collection, and rewards for reporting. Explore the establishment of a mechanism for investigating liability for failure to perform the obligation to assist in enforcement, establish a system to prevent and stop conduct evading enforcement, and lawfully punish acts of refusal to enforce. Cooperate in the legislative work of the Enforcement Law, formulate or revise judicial interpretations such as enforcement of claims, and improve the system of enforcement laws and regulations.

III. Helping to Build a Unified Market for Factors and Resources

8. Support the improvement of a unified urban and rural land market. Properly hear disputes involving the "separation of three rights" in rural land, and promote the orderly transfer of land management rights. Lawfully hear disputes over the market entry of rural collective commercial construction land, and support the accelerated construction of a unified urban and rural construction land market with equal rights, smooth transfer, and shared benefits. With the goal of revitalizing and utilizing land, properly hear cases involving the disposal of land assets in the reform and restructuring of state-owned enterprises and institutions, the determination of property rights of existing allocated land assets, and the listing and trading of such assets. Lawfully hear disputes over the transfer, lease, and mortgage of construction land use rights, and ensure the standardized and efficient use of construction land. Adapt to the adjustment of land supply policies, and unify the adjudication standards for disputes over state-owned land use rights transfer and sale contracts.

9. Support the development of a unified capital market. Lawfully severely punish crimes in the financial field such as market manipulation, insider trading, illegal fundraising, loan fraud, and money laundering, and promote the healthy development of the financial market. Properly hear disputes over financial loan contracts, securities, futures transactions, and bills, and regulate the investment and financing order in the capital market. Lawfully handle disputes involving supply chain finance, internet finance, disposal of non-performing assets, and private investment funds, and help prevent and defuse financial risks. Improve the adjudication rules for new types of disputes such as private equity investment, entrusted wealth management, asset securitization, and cross-border financial asset transactions, strengthen legal research on digital currencies and mobile payments, and serve and safeguard the innovative development of the financial industry.

10. Support the construction of a unified technology and data market. Strengthen judicial protection of the ownership, use rights, disposal rights, and income rights of scientific and technological achievements, properly handle disputes arising from the determination, transfer, pledge, value determination, and benefit distribution of scientific and technological achievements, and lawfully support the market-oriented application of scientific and technological innovation achievements. Lawfully protect the legitimate rights and interests of data rights holders in data control, processing, and income, as well as the property interests of data products developed by data factor market entities based on lawfully collected and self-generated data, properly handle various types of cases arising from data transactions and unfair competition in the data market, and provide judicial guarantees for cultivating a data factor market that is data-driven, cross-border integrated, co-created and shared, and fair competition. Strengthen legal research on the attributes, forms, ownership of data property rights, and public data sharing mechanisms, and accelerate the improvement of judicial protection rules for data property rights.

11. Support the construction of a unified national energy and ecological environment market. Lawfully hear disputes over oil and gas futures products, natural gas, electricity, coal transactions, etc., lawfully severely punish illegal acts such as illegal mining and development, and illegal transactions of oil, natural gas, electricity, and coal, and promote the lawful and orderly development and utilization of resources. Research and release judicial policies to help achieve the goals of carbon peak and carbon neutrality, properly handle disputes involving carbon emission allowances, certified voluntary emission reduction transactions, carbon trading product guarantees, as well as corporate environmental information disclosure, carbon-related green credit, and green finance, and help improve the carbon emission trading mechanism. Fully and accurately apply the green principles and green clauses of the Civil Code, sort out new business formats, new ownership types, and new issues in the carbon emission field, and improve the adjudication rules for disputes involving carbon emission rights, water use rights, emission rights, and energy use rights. Study the application of alternative compensation methods such as carbon sink subscription and technological transformation deduction, and guide enterprises to upgrade their production equipment and technologies to be greener.

IV. Lawfully Maintaining Unified Market Transaction Rules

12. Optimize the judicial guarantee mechanism for the business environment. The rule of law is the best business environment. In light of the requirements for accelerating the establishment of a unified national market, explore the establishment of a judicial service and guarantee business environment indicator system that conforms to China's national conditions and international standards, and increase the weight of service guarantee for business environment construction in assessment work. Issue judicial interpretations and judicial policies for service guarantee for business environment construction. Cooperate with relevant functional departments to carry out pilot projects for business environment innovation, formulate and issue implementation plans for building a rule-of-law business environment, and establish a regular consultation mechanism for the business environment. Rely on judicial big data, establish an analysis and judgment mechanism for the rule-of-law business environment. Increase the publicity of judicial guarantee for the business environment to boost investor confidence. Explore the establishment of an expert advisory committee of the People's Court to optimize the business environment.

13. Help create a fair and honest transaction environment. Effectively implement the Civil Code, issue judicial interpretations on the contract part of the Civil Code, implement the principles of freedom of contract and good faith, protect lawful transaction activities, smooth the circulation of goods and services, and reduce market transaction costs. Improve the supporting mechanism for deeply integrating socialist core values into adjudication and enforcement work, give full play to the function of judicial judgments in distinguishing right from wrong, punishing evil and promoting good, balancing interests, and settling disputes, and guide market entities to enhance their awareness of the rule of law, public consciousness, and rule awareness. Establish a mechanism for preventing, identifying, and punishing false litigation, and lawfully severely punish false litigation crimes. Strengthen credit punishment for persons subject to enforcement who have broken their promises, improve the credit punishment system, refine the hierarchical mechanism of credit punishment, revise and improve the regulations on the management of the list of dishonest persons subject to enforcement, and explore the establishment of systems for rewarding trustworthy persons and rehabilitating the credit of dishonest persons subject to enforcement. Explore the deep integration path of social credit system construction and the adjudication and enforcement work of the People's Court, and promote the establishment and improvement of the mechanism for the collection, sharing, and use of judicial big data related to market entity credit information.

14. Support regional market integration construction. Improve the judicial service and guarantee mechanism for major regional strategies and coordinated regional development, and lawfully support regions such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, the Yangtze River Delta, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, the Chengdu-Chongqing Dual-Circle Economic Zone, and the Yangtze River Midstream City Cluster, under the premise of maintaining a unified national market, to prioritize carrying out regional market integration construction. Give full play to the role of the circuit courts of the Supreme People's Court, improve the work mechanisms such as resource sharing, joint meetings, and judge exchanges among courts in the circuit areas, and actively explore new paths for regional judicial cooperation. Improve cross-regional judicial coordination and cooperation mechanisms, and actively promote typical experiences and practices of judicial service guarantee for regional market integration.

15. Promote the connection and alignment of rules between the Mainland and Hong Kong/Macao, and between the Mainland and Taiwan. Strengthen adjudication work involving Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan, and explore the establishment of a centralized jurisdiction mechanism for commercial cases involving Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan. Strengthen judicial assistance and mutual aid, implement the arrangement between the Mainland and Macao on mutual assistance in preservation in arbitration proceedings, and implement the mechanism between the Mainland and Hong Kong on mutual recognition and assistance in bankruptcy proceedings. Explore simplifying the procedures for judicial confirmation of the litigation subject qualifications of Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan parties and the examination and determination of litigation evidence, expand the channels for cross-border service of litigation documents in cases involving Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan, and broaden the channels for mutual entrustment in ascertaining foreign laws between the Mainland and Hong Kong and Macao. Promote the establishment of a unified certification mechanism for the qualifications of mediation organizations and mediators in Shenzhen, Hong Kong, and Macao, improve the system for Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan residents to serve as special mediators and people's jurors, and lawfully protect the right of qualified Hong Kong and Macao lawyers to practice in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. Improve the judicial exchange mechanism with Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan, promote the establishment of a normalized mechanism for professional seminars among judges in Guangdong, Hong Kong, and Macao, and support the Fujian and Taiwan courts in carrying out practical exchanges.

16. Strengthen the connection between domestic law and international rules. Adhere to the overall promotion of domestic rule of law and foreign-related rule of law, vigorously promote the modernization of the foreign-related adjudication system and adjudication capacity, strengthen the guidance of major foreign-related civil and commercial cases, explore the publication of foreign-related civil and commercial guiding cases in multiple languages, and expand the international influence and credibility of Chinese judicial judgments. Implement the boutique strategy for maritime adjudication, accelerate the construction of an international maritime judicial center, explore and improve the adjudication rules for new types of cases such as the opening of shipping business, international ship registration, coastal transshipment, and ship financial leasing, and create a preferred place for international maritime dispute resolution. Strengthen cooperation in the judicial field with relevant international organizations, countries, and regions, and increase the crackdown on cross-border crimes such as smuggling, money laundering, cyber fraud, and cross-border corruption. Actively participate in the formulation of international rules in the fields of international trade, intellectual property, environmental protection, and cyberspace, and enhance China's voice in international economic governance.

V. Helping to Promote a High-Level Unified Goods and Services Market

17. Strengthen judicial protection of intellectual property. Strengthen judicial protection of intellectual property rights, serve and safeguard technological innovation and the development of emerging industries, and use innovation-driven, high-quality supply to lead and create new demand. Continuously strengthen judicial protection of key technologies in key areas and emerging industries, and the original innovation of innovative small and medium-sized enterprises. Strictly implement systems such as punitive damages for intellectual property infringement and behavioral preservation, and effectively curb intellectual property infringement. Promote the improvement of litigation norms that conform to the trial rules of intellectual property cases, improve the cross-regional jurisdiction system of intellectual property courts, smooth the connection mechanism between intellectual property litigation, arbitration, and mediation, and improve the connection mechanism between intellectual property administrative enforcement and judicial enforcement.

18. Lawfully protect the rights and interests of workers. Properly hear cases such as disputes over equal employment rights, promote the elimination of employment discrimination based on household registration, region, identity, and gender, and promote the smooth cross-regional flow of labor and talent. Strengthen judicial protection for cross-border employment, accurately determine the validity of labor contracts signed between Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan residents who have not obtained employment permits and mainland employers. Issue judicial policies to serve and safeguard the national new urbanization strategy, and lawfully protect the legitimate rights and interests of migrant workers. Study and issue judicial interpretations on civil disputes involving new business formats, and strengthen the protection of labor rights and interests of workers in new business formats. Actively carry out special actions to eradicate wage arrears, lawfully severely punish criminal acts of refusing to pay labor remuneration, and increase the adjudication and enforcement efforts in wage arrears cases. Promote the improvement of the labor dispute resolution system.

19. Help improve commodity quality. Resolutely punish criminal acts such as producing and selling counterfeit and shoddy goods, and endangering food and drug safety. Lawfully and severely punish crimes endangering seed industry safety, such as counterfeiting, trademark infringement, and endangering germplasm resources, and promote the unified protection of national seed resources. Lawfully hear contract and tort disputes arising from commodity quality, accurately apply the punitive damages system, and focus on using civil means to help improve commodity quality. Lawfully hear administrative disputes involving product quality, support administrative organs in deepening the reform of the quality certification system, and strengthen the management of the entire supply chain, entire industry chain, and entire product life cycle. Study and formulate judicial interpretations on hearing cases of crimes endangering production safety, and promote the continuous improvement of the production safety situation.

20. Support the improvement of consumer service quality. Improve the judicial policy support system for expanding domestic demand, and actively create a legal environment conducive to comprehensively promoting consumption. Severely punish fraud crimes in prepaid consumption, properly handle consumer rights protection dispute cases in key livelihood areas such as housing, education and training, medical and health care, elderly care, and childcare, and improve the sense of security and satisfaction of the masses in consumption. Improve the adjudication rules for consumption cases such as online consumption and service consumption, and serve and safeguard consumption upgrades and the development of new consumption models and new business formats. Optimize the trial mechanism for consumer dispute cases, explore the establishment of a collective litigation system for consumer rights protection, improve the public interest litigation system for consumption, promote the establishment of an inter-departmental connection and linkage mechanism for consumer rights protection, and promote the source governance of consumer disputes.

VI. Effectively Maintaining a Unified Market Competition Order

21. Lawfully combat monopolistic and unfair competition behaviors. Strengthen judicial anti-monopoly and anti-unfair competition, lawfully prohibit monopolistic behaviors such as monopoly agreements and abuse of market dominance, severely crack down on unfair competition behaviors such as infringement of trade secrets, malicious squatting of trademarks, and free-riding imitation, and strengthen the trial of unfair competition cases in key areas such as technological innovation, information security, and people's livelihood protection. Strengthen judicial regulation of platform enterprise monopolies, timely stop behaviors that exclude or restrict competition using data, algorithms, technical means, etc., lawfully severely punish behaviors that undermine fair competition and disrupt market order, such as forced "choose one from two," big data price discrimination, low-price dumping, and forced tying, and prevent platform monopolies and disorderly capital expansion. Lawfully severely crack down on behaviors such as extortion of enterprises by self-media operators using public opinion influence, and unfair competition behaviors such as maliciously defaming the business reputation and commodity reputation of merchants. Improve the adjudication rules for competition cases, and timely issue judicial interpretations on anti-monopoly civil litigation.

22. Supervise and support administrative organs in strengthening unified market supervision and law enforcement. Revise and improve the judicial interpretation for adjudicating government information disclosure cases, lawfully adjudicate government information disclosure cases in the field of market supervision, and promote administrative organs to strictly follow statutory authority and procedures in disclosing market supervision rules. Lawfully and properly adjudicate administrative dispute cases involving discretionary powers in market supervision, authorized or delegated supervision and law enforcement, and cross-administrative-region joint law enforcement, and supervise and support administrative organs in improving comprehensive law enforcement efficiency and ensuring fair and impartial law enforcement. Strengthen coordination with procuratorial organs, and jointly promote market supervision departments to establish a regulatory system with clear powers and responsibilities, well-defined division of labor, and smooth operation through adjudicating administrative public interest litigation cases and issuing judicial recommendations. Strengthen communication and collaboration with market supervision and law enforcement departments to promote the unification of administrative adjudication rules and enforcement standards in the field of unified market supervision.

23. Lawfully punish illegal and criminal acts that disrupt market order. Research and formulate judicial interpretations for adjudicating tax-related criminal cases, lawfully punish illegal and criminal acts such as tax evasion, tax resistance, tax fraud, and false issuance of special VAT invoices, and increase the severity of punishment for acts such as tax evasion through the use of "yin-yang contracts" and tax evasion by high-net-worth individuals in the cultural and entertainment sectors. Strengthen coordination with tax, public security, and other departments in law enforcement and judicial efforts to promote the improvement of the tax supervision system. Accurately grasp the criminalization standards for illegal and criminal acts such as contract fraud and forced transactions, lawfully determine the validity of related contracts, and uphold the autonomy of market entities. Lawfully severely punish acts of evading debts through false litigation, fraudulent bankruptcy, and fraudulently obtaining property. Research and formulate judicial interpretations for adjudicating criminal cases of illegal business operations, and strictly regulate the standards for conviction and sentencing in criminal cases of illegal business operations. Research and formulate judicial interpretations on the application of law in adjudicating criminal cases of malfeasance, and make provisions on the handling of malfeasance crimes by state functionaries that hinder the development of the market economy.

24. Assist in coordinating the advancement of pandemic prevention and control with economic and social development. Lawfully severely punish crimes such as fraud, price gouging, hoarding and profiteering, rumormongering, and the production and sale of fake or substandard drugs, medical devices, and medical hygiene materials during the pandemic, and maintain the order of production and daily life during pandemic prevention and control. Properly handle contract breach and corporate debt disputes arising from the pandemic, accurately apply the force majeure rule, and reasonably balance the interests of the parties. Precisely serve the "six stability" and "six guarantees" tasks, properly handle civil and commercial disputes arising from the pandemic, such as labor and employment, purchase and sale contracts, and commercial lease disputes, continuously improve judicial policies benefiting the people and enterprises, and help industries, small and medium-sized enterprises, and individual businesses severely impacted by the pandemic to overcome difficulties.

VII. Improve the Working Mechanism for Judicial Services and Guarantees

25. Deepen the reform of the litigation system. Strictly follow the reform deployment requirements to systematically integrate and advance various work measures for comprehensive and coordinated reform of the judicial system, and effectively meet the judicial needs of market entities for efficient, convenient, and fair dispute resolution. Strengthen the concept of protecting the right of action, and resolutely implement the case registration system. Steadily advance the reform of the functional orientation of trial levels in courts of four levels, optimize the standards for jurisdiction over civil, commercial, and administrative cases of different levels, improve the procedures for retrial applications and case registration standards, and perfect the mechanism for transferring cases under jurisdiction to higher-level courts for trial, promoting the trial of cases with universal legal guidance significance and concerning public interests by higher-level courts. Earnestly implement the newly revised Civil Procedure Law, fully utilize the outcomes of the reform of simplified and expedited procedures, issue judicial interpretations on the application of law in expedited civil procedures, and further promote the classification of cases into simple and complex, the separation of major and minor cases, and the differentiation of fast and slow tracks.

26. Improve the working mechanism for unified application of law. Strengthen the management of judicial interpretations, perfect the system of guiding cases, establish a national platform for unified application of law by courts, build a database of adjudication rules for similar cases, implement a mandatory retrieval system for similar cases and new types of cases, improve the working mechanism of collegial panels and professional judge meetings, fully leverage the functions of the adjudication committee, and construct a multi-level and multi-dimensional mechanism for resolving divergences in the application of law. Improve and perfect the system of judicial openness, and increase the integration of the four major platforms for judicial openness. Advance the construction of a judicial restraint and supervision system, fully implement the system of power responsibility lists and performance guidance for trial work, perfect the mechanism for identifying and supervising the "four categories of cases", and construct a scientifically reasonable system for determining and pursuing judicial responsibility.

27. Deepen the construction of a one-stop diversified dispute resolution and litigation service system. Uphold and develop the "Fengqiao experience" in the new era, place non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms at the forefront, promote systematic, comprehensive, and source governance of disputes and conflicts, and effectively reduce the cost of dispute resolution for market entities. Highlight the five key elements of one-stop, intensive, integrated, online, and smart, and build a modern litigation service system that is intensive and efficient, diversified in dispute resolution, convenient and beneficial to the people, smart and precise, open and interactive, and integrated and shared. Leverage the integration role of the court mediation platform, perfect the linkage system between judicial mediation and people's mediation and administrative mediation, and strengthen the substantive connection between litigation and non-litigation. Increase the use of online video mediation, and establish and improve specialized mediation mechanisms for labor disputes, financial insurance, securities and futures, intellectual property, and other areas.

28. Strengthen the construction of internet judiciary and smart courts. Promote the deep integration of the internet, big data, artificial intelligence, and blockchain with trial and enforcement work, use the judicial data mid-platform and the smart court brain as the driving force, promote intelligent collaborative applications, expand data knowledge services, construct an integrated cloud and network infrastructure, and improve quality, efficiency, and operational maintenance levels. Advance the implementation of the "Provisions on Online Litigation of People's Courts", "Provisions on Online Mediation of People's Courts", and "Provisions on Online Operation of People's Courts", further improve and perfect the norms for online judicial procedures, optimize platform construction, and promote the maturation and standardization of the internet judicial model. Deepen the construction of internet courts, promote the improvement of the establishment of internet courts and the scope of case jurisdiction, and fully leverage the normative guiding role of internet courts in establishing rules, perfecting systems, and network governance.

29. Improve the level of service guarantee capability. Firmly adhere to the Party's absolute leadership over judicial work, insist on using Party building to lead team building and promote trials, and promote the deep integration and mutual promotion of Party building and trial business work. Intensify the training of high-level trial talents in the fields of intellectual property, environmental resources, foreign-related rule of law, bankruptcy, finance, antitrust, and others, and cultivate a number of trial business experts who firmly embrace market-oriented thinking and are proficient in related business areas. Strengthen guidance on trial business in related fields through education and training, case guidance, and exchange seminars, and the Supreme People's Court will timely issue guiding cases and typical cases in related fields. Fully utilize various research platforms and resources of the courts, strengthen investigation and research on major issues, and produce high-quality research results.

30. Strengthen organizational implementation guarantees. People's courts at all levels shall regard serving and guaranteeing the accelerated construction of a unified national market as a major political task, list it as an important agenda item of the Party leadership group, promptly study and resolve new situations and problems arising in the course of work, and conduct self-inspection and cleanup on whether there are regulations and actual situations that hinder the construction of a unified national market. Relevant departments of the Supreme People's Court shall strengthen guidance along their respective lines, and courts in various regions shall, in light of actual local economic and social development conditions, refine and improve service guarantee measures, introduce new, hard, and practical measures, and ensure that various service guarantee measures are implemented and take effect. Earnestly summarize good experiences and practices in judicial service guarantee for building a unified national market, and conduct all-media, multi-angle, and three-dimensional publicity, summarization, and promotion, creating a favorable public opinion atmosphere for accelerating the construction of a unified national market.

July 14, 2022
